title: Natural automorphism adjustment of the K-flat pullback counit to the supplied translated-unit shift
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of Noetherian schemes with recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe. Let F=Lf* be derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] with a supplied strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and let H be the homotopy functor induced by additive termwise tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write Qh_X for localization and c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] for the canonical shift-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Fix a natural transformation ε₀:Qh_Y⋙F→H⋙Qh_Z invertible at each K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There exist an isomorphism e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] and a natural automorphism a of Qh_Y⋙F. Put ε=a.hom≫ε₀ and G=H⋙Qh_Z. For every homotopy object X, ε(X[1])≫commShift_G(X) equals F(commShift_Qh_Y(X))≫b(Qh_Y(X))≫ε(X)[1], where b(K) is F(c_Y(K) inverse), followed by the supplied inverse tensorator at (O_Y[1],K), e tensor identity, and c_Z(F(K)). This is a shift-square normalization, with no mapping-cone assertion.

proof.text: Compute derived pullback on K-flat representatives. Represent the unit and its shift by the structure-sheaf complex and its translate, and apply termwise pullback. Rewrite translation by the first-variable Koszul comparison followed by the translated left unitor. Transport the rewrite using the supplied inverse tensorator and the monoidal unit map, choosing the representative comparison jointly with this rewrite. Tensorator associativity and unit equations give its translation square with the displayed translated-unit composite; naturality of the Koszul maps and tensorator makes this comparison compatible with representative maps.

Compare the normalized representative comparison with the given ε₀. Their ratio is an isomorphism on each K-flat representative. Naturality makes these ratios compatible with replacement maps; the resolving-class universal property descends the ratios and inverse ratios to a natural automorphism a of Qh followed by derived pullback. Their compositions are identities because they are identities on the resolving class. The normalized counit is a.hom followed by ε₀. Descend the shift square through the same universal property, giving the asserted formula on every homotopy object. Zero complexes and empty schemes satisfy the equations by uniqueness of maps between zero objects.

theorem exists_derivedPullback_kFlat_counit_shift_adjustment
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (ε₀ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
          schemeDerivedCategory Z))
    (hε₀ : ∀ P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
      IsIso (ε₀.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))) :
    ∃ e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ∃ a : (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f),
        let ε := a.hom ≫ ε₀
        ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        ε.app (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ (G.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            (ε.app X)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
